integrity: The published corona formula and qualitative instability precedents are credited; no independent certification or priority claim is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts half-plane and boundary roots but does not compute all their complex coordinates; its all-parameter validity rests on an explicit proof, not finite experiments. The independence-polynomial factorization was known previously. Bibliographic priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Exact independence-root phase diagram for clique coronas with independent leaves
